name: Patchbay
description: A plain-spoken support page: big title and lede, contact cards first, then the common issues as ruled rows with muted answers, all open. Dark.
features: Contact cards above the questions (front-door section order)
Ruled rows, no disclosure icon, muted answers, no feedback row
An “Or email …” line under the cards
Zero custom CSS — every detail is a theme setting

collections.name: Common issues
collections.description: The questions we answer most, answered once.

pages.title: Why is my data not updating?
pages.markdown: Sync runs every five minutes. If a change has not appeared after ten, open **Settings → Connections** and choose **Sync now**. A red dot next to a connection means its credentials expired.

pages.title: The API returns 401 Unauthorized. What’s wrong?
pages.markdown: The key is missing, revoked or sent in the wrong header. Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, and check under **Settings → API keys** that it is still active.

pages.title: How do I export my data?
pages.markdown: Every table has an **Export** button that downloads a CSV of the rows you are looking at, filters included. For everything at once, use **Settings → Export workspace**.

pages.title: What are the API rate limits?
pages.markdown: 100 requests per second per workspace, with bursts up to 200. A `429` response includes a `Retry-After` header telling you how long to wait.

collections.name: Account
collections.description: Sign-in, team members and your plan.

pages.title: Can we sign in with our company’s identity provider?
pages.markdown: Yes, on the Team plan and above. Add your provider under **Settings → Security → Single sign-on**; members are moved over the next time they sign in.

pages.title: What happens when I remove a member?
pages.markdown: They lose access straight away. Anything they created stays in the workspace and is reassigned to you.
